notes:
Summary: mid-market contact center vendor building customer-facing agent assist + automated tooling. Primary ask: reliable tool-calling to support systems (create/update tickets, refunds, escalations) with graceful degradation under spikes.

Recent meetings / call snippets:
- 2026-01-28 discovery: Marco + Jules + VP Ops (HarborPulse). They emphasized: "must be able to call our internal ticket API and Zendesk concurrently; ops must see audit trail and idempotency."
- 2026-02-15 SE deep-dive (ff_2026-02-15_9ab34): went through auth options (mTLS vs signed JWT), webhook patterns, and retry semantics. SE notes: HarborPulse uses a legacy ticket API that sometimes returns 500 under load; want Redwood to create stub tickets locally and reconcile.
- 2026-02-28 pricing/legal intro: procurement asked for token-level cost estimates for spiky traffic and a sample SLA on fallback behavior.

Technical asks / constraints (customer language / shorthand):
- tool-calls must be idempotent; prefer Redwood SDK for tool-calls + example terraform + 1-click webhook templates
- support refunds via a separate refund-service API (two-phase: pre-check then post-refund webhook)
- escalation: auto-open high-priority tickets + notify on Slack, ability to push to 3rd-party escalation queue
- traffic profile: normal agent-assist steady-state ~25-40 rps, spikes up to 150-200 rps during incidents/Black Fri tests
- throughput for ticket create/update endpoints: target 200 TPS at peak; acceptable to queue async if downstream slow but must expose status and ensure at-least-once or at-most-once per config
- latency goals: streaming token latency <300ms p95 for assistant; end-to-end ticket create (including downstream call) p95 <1s preferred, <2s acceptable for large payloads
- security: SSO + SCIM for admin, audit logs for each tool-call, envelope encryption with customer KMS, residency requirement: store PII only in NA region

POC scope and success criteria:
- run 2-week POC with Canary routing: primary->internal API, fallback->Zendesk stub with structured JSON, verify no duplicated tickets (idempotency test), validate audit logs and KMS integration
- failure modes: test downstream 5xx/429 and verify Redwood falls back to stub ticket creation & logs escalation to ops channel
- perf: demonstrate 2x sustained bursts to 180 rps for 10 min with <5% error on tool-calls

Quotes & remarks:
- VP Ops: "If you can guarantee no-ticket-doubles and solid audit logs, we can replace our glue code."
- Engineering: wants code sample in Node + Python showing tool-call hooks, token caching for long-running agent sessions.

Artifacts linked: pricing deck, POC runbook, fireflies transcript, intro security FAQ (drive). Jira tickets for integration issues created (SUP-8721).

Sales notes / shorthand:
- upsell path: dedicated pools for region+SLA; add Optimize for batching suggestions to reduce unit cost
- procurement cadence: final approval during May budget window; legal wants data residency appendix

Status: POC approved by VP CS; waiting on infra team to enable mTLS for internal APIs (blocker).
